correctness.rationale: Exact Q(sqrt5) orientation-chamber clipping and sign arithmetic give 968 exhaustive octant-refined cells, ten joint facet-count classes, maximum 18, and exactly twenty congruent favorable spherical hexagons. Each hexagon has six vertices defined by two successive vertex-normal planes; exact inequalities exclude intrusion by all other great circles. Its alternating inward-normal dot products are (88−√5)/109 and (25−4√5)/109; Girard spherical excess yields the stated exact probability.

value.rationale: The canonical 12-pentagon/20-hexagon Archimedean solid has a natural and previously-unresolved-looking extreme panel-intersection probability. The result supplies a sharp maximum, positive-measure classification of all ten joint crossing signatures and an unexpected exact twenty-congruent-hexagon spherical probability law, rather than only isolated sample sections or a routine specialization of a known probability table.
